verdict.rationale: Access certification is a fair question for an identity and governance product, but the evidence pack never documents access reviews or certification campaigns, reviewer routing, recurring review schedules, or sign-off records. The nearby evidence covers other features: lifecycle workflows handle joiner/mover/leaver processes, entitlement management handles access-package assignment, and diagnostic settings handle log routing. None of these is periodic re-justification of access.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
